newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down on selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down on selling pressure.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down sharply in panic selling by investors wary about future of the economy, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 78.4 points or 5.48 percent at 1,345.37 on a turnover of 75.7 million taka. The losers led gainers by 109 to six. "The share prices continued to slide as investors are avoiding any commitment mainly because of the news that companies suffer production losses due to frequent power disruptions," said one broker.
Leasing company IDLC lost 377 taka to 4,319, Bangladesh Lamps shed 395 to 5,450 and Lexco Limited was up 23 to 566.
